title: Benzoylpaeoniflorin alleviates psoriasis-like inflammation by modulating immune balance and inhibiting NF-kappaB signaling pathway.
authors: Wei, Jingjing; Li, Mingming; Du, Lingyun; Lv, Shanrong; Leng, Yi; Zhao, Xiaoke; Yu, Kemei; Xu, Qingqing; Zhang, Chunhong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯甲酰芍药苷对银屑病样炎症的缓解作用，涉及NF-κB信号通路和分子对接，但核心是免疫炎症机制而非蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Psoriasis is a common chronic immune-inflammatory skin disease that remains a challenge to treat. Benzoylpaeoniflorin (BPF) is a monoterpenoid glycoside derived from the roots of Paeonia albiflora Pall., a plant in the peony family (Paeoniaceae). It has shown promising anti-inflammatory effects. However, its therapeutic efficacy in psoriasis has not yet been investigated. This study aims to evaluate the therapeutic effects of BPF in Imiquimod (IMQ)-induced psoriasis-like lesions and to elucidate its underlying mechanisms. METHODS: The psoriasis-like model was established in SKH-1 mice using IMQ to evaluate the in vivo efficacy of BPF. Flow cytometry was employed to analyze the proportions of immune cells in the spleen and peripheral blood of the mice. RNA-sequencing was used to screen the differentially expressed genes and key signaling pathways in BPF-treated mice. Molecular docking was used to simulate the binding mode of BPF and potential targets. The human keratinocytes cells (HaCaT) and bone marrow-derived dendritic cells (BMDCs) were used to assess the inhibitory effects of BPF on cell proliferation, cell maturation and the activation of the TNF-alpha/NF-kappaB signaling pathway. RESULTS: BPF improved the clinical symptoms and histological features of psoriasis-like lesions in IMQ-treated SKH-1 mice. BPF reduced the proportions of lymphocytes and dendritic cells (DCs), modulated the ratio of Th17/Treg cells and promoted immune balance restoration. RNA-sequencing analysis showed that BPF ameliorated psoriasis by modulating multiple immune-related and cytokine-associated signaling pathways, including the NF-kappaB, TNF-alpha, and IL-17 signaling pathways. Molecular docking demonstrated that BPF may play an anti-psoriasis role by interfering with the formation of TNF-alpha trimer and binding TNF-alpha to TNF-R. BPF inhibited TNF-alpha-induced proliferation of HaCaT cells and maturation of DCs, as well as TNF-alpha-induced activation of NF-kappaB and secretion of inflammatory cytokines. CONCLUSIONS: BPF alleviates psoriasis-like inflammation through multiple mechanisms, offering new insights into potential therapeutic strategies.
abstract_zh: 背景：银屑病是一种常见的慢性免疫炎症性皮肤病，治疗上仍具挑战性。苯甲酰芍药苷（BPF）是一种源自芍药科植物芍药（Paeonia albiflora Pall.）根部的单萜糖苷，已显示出良好的抗炎效果。然而，其在银屑病中的治疗作用尚未被研究。本研究旨在评估BPF在咪喹莫特（IMQ）诱导的银屑病样病变中的治疗效果，并阐明其潜在机制。方法：使用IMQ在SKH-1小鼠中建立银屑病样模型，以评估BPF的体内疗效。采用流式细胞术分析小鼠脾脏和外周血中免疫细胞的比例。利用RNA测序筛选BPF处理小鼠中的差异表达基因和关键信号通路。使用分子对接模拟BPF与潜在靶点的结合模式。使用人角质形成细胞（HaCaT）和骨髓来源树突状细胞（BMDCs）评估BPF对细胞增殖、细胞成熟以及TNF-α/NF-κB信号通路激活的抑制作用。结果：BPF改善了IMQ处理的SKH-1小鼠银屑病样病变的临床症状和组织学特征。BPF降低了淋巴细胞和树突状细胞（DCs）的比例，调节了Th17/Treg细胞比值，并促进了免疫平衡的恢复。RNA测序分析显示，BPF通过调节多种免疫相关和细胞因子相关信号通路（包括NF-κB、TNF-α和IL-17信号通路）来改善银屑病。分子对接表明，BPF可能通过干扰TNF-α三聚体的形成以及TNF-α与TNF-R的结合来发挥抗银屑病作用。BPF抑制了TNF-α诱导的HaCaT细胞增殖和DCs成熟，以及TNF-α诱导的NF-κB激活和炎症细胞因子分泌。结论：BPF通过多种机制缓解银屑病样炎症，为潜在治疗策略提供了新见解。
